Main purpose: Introduces the seizure prediction problem, motivation, and research gap
Reviews patient-specific vs patient-independent prediction, cross-dataset generalisation, and prior seizure prediction methods
Defines datasets, preprocessing, harmonisation, feature extraction, models, and evaluation metrics
Reports baseline and CNN patient-independent performance on CHB-MIT
Shows upper-bound performance under same-patient training/testing
Evaluates zero-shot external transfer from CHB-MIT to Siena
Assesses whether limited target-domain adaptation improves external performance
Examines event sensitivity and approximate false positive burden
Interprets patient heterogeneity, dataset shift, threshold effects, and practical limitations
Summarises the main findings and implications for future seizure prediction systems
